answer: Every identity posts one ferrous bond tied to a single signal of completed work, and that signal only counts once three randomly drawn peers replay it against the shale record of prior jobs. A peer that confirms a fake signal loses its own bond, so collusion costs the verifiers too. Each fake identity must therefore pay one full bond plus three fresh verified jobs, and the cost cannot be pooled or reused across clones, so ten fakes cost ten bonds and thirty jobs.
